metadata.description:
A Yoto Original podcast perfect for big thinkers and kids who love asking 'why?', The Download is hosted by Pema and Jake of Yoto Daily, and structured like an audio magazine. Each themed episode of The Download shares stories and perspectives from experts and thinkers on topics big and small, and ends with an instalment of our serialised fictional narrative - the Teatimers. For curious kids with expansive imaginations who know there is always more to learn. 

Ages 9-12.

Listen to Season 1 for the download on ‘Creativity and Tech’, ‘Repair and Maintenance’, and ‘Habitats’.

Expect Season 2 in 2026!

Produced by Yoto.
